The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends an A1C goal of **<7%** for many nonpregnant adults with type 2 diabetes who do not experience significant hypoglycemia [ADA, 2024]. This target balances glycemic control benefits with risks of hypoglycemia and other complications. Individualized adjustments may be necessary based on patient-specific factors, as noted in the guideline. 

**Source**: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, "Glycemic Targets & Pharmacologic Approaches," 2024 [ADA, 2024].
